title: Sub04 Batch 1C — Hinokami Combo & Clear Blue Sky vs Blood Lightning (s10..s13 + s08_i2va + s11_i2va)
hypothesis: Shared-lineage 1344x768 keyframes kf00..kf20 with 39f FL2VA multi-seed Gacha outperform I2VA and 73f merged windows while keeping input_jobs.tar <= 16.5 MB for zero Stage 0 upload timeouts.

shots.title: 火之神神乐·烈日斩碎血甲 (Solar C-Curve Armor-Shattering Slash)
shots.description: Out of the high-speed zigzag blitz in Picture 1 at 0.00s, the Demon Slayer closes to point-blank range and unleashes a massive C-shaped upward solar flame slash that shatters the silver-haired demon's dark-crimson blood armor in Picture 2 at 1.62s. A blinding golden-white impact flash and thousands of glowing ember particles erupt between the two fighters.
shots.soundscape: Deafening fiery blade impact, shattering crystalline blood armor, roaring flames, and demon snarl.
shots.music: Explosive orchestral brass hit with rapid taiko accents.

shots.title: 火之神神乐·碧罗之天回旋火轮 (Clear Blue Sky 360-Degree Solar Flame Ring)
shots.description: From the close-range armor-shattering slash in Picture 1 at 0.00s, the Demon Slayer somersaults high into the night sky and spins his flaming katana in a complete 360-degree halo of crimson-and-gold solar fire framed directly against the giant silver full moon in Picture 2 at 1.62s. Swirling golden sparks and red maple leaves orbit the blazing solar wheel.
shots.soundscape: Ascending wind rush, circular roaring vortex of solar fire, and resonant metallic katana ring.
shots.music: Soaring choir and high strings over thunderous kagura drums.

shots.title: 上弦血鬼术·赤黑雷涡爆发 (Blood Demon Art: Crimson Lightning Vortex)
shots.description: As the solar flame ring shines overhead in Picture 1 at 0.00s, the camera whips down to the courtyard where the enraged silver-haired Upper-Rank demon spreads both clawed hands and unleashes a violent tornado of black-and-crimson Blood Demon Art lightning and razor-sharp blood crescents in Picture 2 at 1.62s, splintering the surrounding wooden railings.
shots.soundscape: Ear-splitting crackle of dark crimson lightning, demonic energy roar, and splintering castle timber.
shots.music: Menacing low brass, dissonant strings, and thunderous percussion.

shots.title: 半空烈焰对轰血雷·极光冲击波 (Mid-Air Solar Flame vs Crimson Lightning Clash)
shots.description: From the demon's erupting blood-lightning vortex in Picture 1 at 0.00s, the Demon Slayer dives diagonally from the upper left and slams his blazing solar katana directly into the demon's crimson lightning claws in mid-air at 1.62s (Picture 2). Golden solar fire fills the left half of the frame while black-crimson lightning fills the right, sending a radial shockwave ring across the moonlit sky.
shots.soundscape: Cataclysmic mid-air collision of fire and lightning, metallic shockwave boom, and crackling energy arcs.
shots.music: Full orchestral tutti climax with rapid taiko and choir.

shots.title: [Workflow B I2VA] 火之神神乐·圆舞仅首帧约束 (I2VA Hinokami Kagura First Slash)
shots.description: Starting from <Picture 1> at 0.00s with his flaming katana held horizontally, the Demon Slayer leaps forward and swings a wide downward arc of crimson-and-gold ukiyo-e solar fire across the moonlit courtyard.
shots.soundscape: Roaring solar flame whoosh, explosive katana slash, and crackling embers.
shots.music: Blazing kagura taiko drums and heroic brass.

shots.title: [Workflow B I2VA] 碧罗之天回旋火轮·仅首帧约束 (I2VA Clear Blue Sky Flame Ring)
shots.description: Starting from <Picture 1> at 0.00s after shattering the demon's blood armor, the Demon Slayer leaps into the night sky and spins his flaming sword in a 360-degree crimson-and-gold solar ring under the full moon.
shots.soundscape: Upward leap whoosh and circular roaring vortex of solar fire.
shots.music: Soaring choir and high strings over taiko drums.
